ideas.pitch: A supply chain visibility and auditing platform that uncovers hidden animal welfare violations in local food and textile manufacturing using multi-modal sensor inputs.
ideas.title: MercyTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the mission of sponsor Mercy For Animals by providing concrete supply chain transparency tools that expose invisible industry practices.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative wireframing and ideation plugin powered by Miro that analyzes whiteboard session metadata to automatically flag conflicting design assumptions before coding begins.
ideas.title: InvisibleInk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Miro ecosystem directly, making it extremely attractive for winning sponsor-specific integrations and productivity prizes.

ideas.pitch: An automated refactoring and code comprehension pipeline built on top of CodeCrafters challenges to detect hidden anti-patterns and performance bottlenecks in low-level implementations.
ideas.title: DevCodeInspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to CodeCrafters judges by focusing on deep code mastery, systems programming hygiene, and advanced runtime analysis.

ideas.pitch: A local air quality and urban heat-island anomaly detector that aggregates disparate open-access sensor feeds to reveal micro-climatic patterns invisible to standard weather apps.
ideas.title: AuraScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the core hackathon tagline 'Build beyond what's visible' by surfacing environmental hazards that ordinary city dashboards overlook.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized developer bounty coordination platform built on Devfolio and OSEN integrations to securely match hackathon participants with micro-tasks using cryptographic escrow.
ideas.title: PeerlessNetwork
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates key ecosystem tools promoted by Devfolio and OSEN, hitting the infrastructure sponsor sweet spot for judging panels.
